QuestInfo.name: First Time Together Training
QuestInfo.0: As #p1101002# instructed, go see #btraining instructor #p1102000##k.\n#bTraining instructor #p1102000##k can be found at the Entrance to the Drill Hall located at the end of the Training Forest.\n
QuestInfo.1: #p1102000# told me he expected me to come and suggested that I take the Acclimation Training before entering Victoria Island. He then proposed that I head over to the end of the Training Forest and enter #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k to hunt the #r#o9300271#s#k that are inside.\n\n#o9300271##r #a207011##k

0.0: Haha, so you're here! #p1101002# would have never let you out when you have just become a Knight-in-Training. I'm sure he said something along the lines of you diligently training until you reach Level 13.
0.1: What is there to do except train anyway. This is all for your own good, and for the good of the Cygnus Knights. Now, let's work on the training.

yes.0: The training you are about to undergo entails you getting acclimated to monsters outside Ereve, which means you are training for the real world. You'll need to do that sooner or later, anyway.
yes.1: You'll see #r#o9300271##k dummies in the #b1st Drill Hall#k. Defeat #r20 of#k them.

no.0: Hmmm? What is it? If you don't like the way #p1101002# talks, then don't mind him. He's always like that anyway, so you might as well get used to him.

1.0: Wow, you defeated those #o9300271# dummies so quickly! Keep this up and your training will go swimmingly.

yes.0: Talk to me when you're ready to take on the next step.

mob.0: It seems like you haven't defeated #r20 #o9300271##k dummies yet. Go to the #b1st Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and practice battling!
